name: Lionel's Barber Shop
tagline: Old-school cuts on Highland Drive, Aggie-run since 2005.
about: Lionel Garcia owns and runs this neighborhood barbershop on Highland Drive. The Battalion describes it as Aggie-run and operated since 2005.
Reviewers call Lionel an old-school barber, and they mention the conversation as much as the haircut.
hours_source: Hours as listed on the shop's public Birdeye/Google profile. Call or stop by to confirm before a holiday.

reviews.name: Joe
reviews.text: I love going to the barber shop enjoy the conversation and always a professional experience, thanks. Gig'em Aggies

reviews.name: Manuel
reviews.text: Lionel is an old-school top of the line barber!

sources: Address, weekly hours, 4.8 rating from 63 reviews, review quotes: https://reviews.birdeye.com/lionels-barber-shop-170237709069783
Owner Lionel Garcia; Aggie-run and operated since 2005: The Battalion, https://thebatt.com/life-arts/lionels-barbershop/
Only web presence found: a directory page at lionels-barber-shop.jany.io (not an owned website).
conflicts: No public phone number was found on the listings used, so the page has no Call button.
